Licenses; Certificates; Special Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in education, social work, human services, psychology, social sciences or a closely related field and two (2) years of increasingly responsible experience coordinating student programs, educational initiatives, community engagement, or student support services in a college or university; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
Education, Training and Experience:
GENERAL PURPOSE

Under the direction of an assigned administrator, coordinates the day-to-day operations of the Asian American, Native Hawaiian, Pacific Islander (AANHPI) Student Achievement Program (SAP) plan, MANA Program, and collaborates with the APID Resource group. This role is responsible for event calendar management, scheduling student activities, and recruiting students to the programs and MANA Learning Community. The position will identify and support student needs to enhance academic success, retention, and graduation for Asian, Pacific Islander, and Desi (APID) students and perform related duties as assigned. DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS

The AANHPI & MANA Programs Coordinator is responsible for providing direct, day-to-day organizational and technical coordination of programs and services organized through the AANHPI and MANA Programs and plan strategies. The incumbent acts and assists in ensuring students’ activities are carried out according to district policies, procedures, and practices, as well as pertinent laws, regulations and codes. This position provides some administrative coverage for the department and specific duties may differ by assignment and responsibilities varied depending on the types of student groups, facilities and student events/activities that are delegated.
For the full position description, please click here Asian American, Native Hawaiian, Pacific Islander (AANHPI) & MANA Programs Coordinator .

Meeting the minimum requirements of the position does not guarantee advancement in the selection process. Candidate qualifications will be assessed to determine those who meet and exceed requirements, and are deemed most competitive amongst the applicant pool to proceed.
